flags.text: Buys and resells 4,381 head in three years (2.9x its yearly capacity) after a median 32 days on the farm, too short for any weight gain, and 100% of what it buys traces back to flagged ranches. This is the triangulation pattern used to launder cattle.
flags.title: Resells animals after a median 32 days

flags.text: PRODES maps 17.8 ha of post-2020 deforestation. It may be licensed under Brazilian law, but it breaks the EUDR zero-deforestation rule for EU-bound beef.
flags.title: 17.8 ha cleared after 2020
